Message:
That voice I’m hearing
from inside the cave...
Is that truly Florence’s?

She sounds so frail,
I can’t imagine this being
the same Florence I know.

—I can’t even keep
one single promise.
Someone like me
has no right to be
by her side...!

Wait...
She has been alone
this whole time,
carrying this guilt...

That must be why
she’d sometimes look
like something was
weighing on her mind...

For me to not even notice that...
and selfishly wish that
I’d be the one she turned to...

No... There’s still
something I can do.

“I’ll break you out of there,
so just hold on a little longer...!”

First, I must purge the
poison corroding her body.

Placing a hand against
an ice-cold boulder,
I silenced the world
around me and prayed...

Florence should be cleansed
of the poison by now...
but, her voice was still
tinged with suffering...

“Yet another”...?
Those words made my heart
ache with sorrow.

I didn’t realize Florence had
kept blaming herself like that.

Please, don’t apologize anymore.
You don’t need to push yourself
and act strong when
you’re with me.

After all,
we are the closest of friends.
You protect me,
and I trust you,
but there’s much more
to us than that.

We can protect each other...
Trust and turn to each other.
That’s how I want us to be
after we overcome this trial.

...So this time,
I’ll be the one who saves you.
